title: symphyotrichum × versicolor
intro: Symphyotrichum × versicolor, commonly known as New England aster, is a hybrid plant species of the Asteraceae family, native to Eastern North America. It is known for its vibrant purple flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum × versicolor include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
